{"summary": "Implemented even_bit_set_number by setting the 2nd, 4th, 6th, ... bits (1-based from LSB) up to the most significant bit, so 10 remains 10.", "files": {"solution.py": """"Write a python function to set all even bits of a given number."""


def even_bit_set_number(n):
    """Write a python function to set all even bits of a given number.

    Bits are counted starting at 1 for the least significant bit, so
    the even bits are the 2nd, 4th, 6th, ... bits (zero-based indices
    1, 3, 5, ...). Only bits up to the most significant set bit of
    ``n`` are considered, so no new higher bits are introduced.
    """
    if n <= 0:
        return n
    mask = 0
    for bit_index in range(1, n.bit_length(), 2):
        mask |= 1 << bit_index
    return n | mask
